data.name: Error.400.Description
data.value: The request was malformed and the server couldn't make sense of it. If you reached this page from a link, the link may be broken.

data.value: You need to be signed in to view this page. If you were signed in already, your session may have expired — sign in again to continue.

data.value: This tenant's subscription is past due or the current plan doesn't include the feature you tried to access. Pay the latest invoice or upgrade your plan to continue.

data.value: Your account is signed in, but it doesn't have permission for this page. Ask a tenant admin to grant you the relevant role, or switch to an account that has access.

data.value: We couldn't find the page you were looking for. It may have moved, or the link you followed could be out of date.

data.name: Error.404.PathInfo
data.value: We couldn't find anything at {0}. It may have moved, or the link you followed could be out of date.

data.name: Error.405.Description
data.value: This endpoint doesn't accept the HTTP method you used. If you arrived here from a form, the form's target route may have changed — head back and try again.

data.name: Error.408.Description
data.value: The server didn't get a complete request in time. This usually means a slow network — wait a moment, then try again.

data.name: Error.410.Description
data.value: This resource used to be here but has been permanently removed. There's no forwarding address — try searching from the home page.

data.name: Error.422.Description
data.value: The data you sent was understood, but something didn't pass validation. Check the fields you submitted and try again.

data.name: Error.429.Description
data.value: You've made too many requests in a short window. We've slowed you down to keep the system fair for everyone — try again in a minute.

data.name: Error.500.Description
data.value: An unexpected error happened while we tried to serve your request. The site team has been notified — try again, or come back in a few minutes.

data.name: Error.502.Description
data.value: An upstream service we depend on returned an invalid response. This usually clears itself within a minute or two — try again shortly.

data.name: Error.503.Description
data.value: We're either down for maintenance or under heavy load. We'll be back online shortly — refresh the page in a couple of minutes.

data.name: Error.504.Description
data.value: An upstream service took too long to respond. The request didn't reach completion — try again shortly.

data.name: Error.Generic.ServerDescription
data.value: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or come back in a few minutes.

data.name: Error.Generic.RequestDescription
data.value: The request couldn't be completed. Check the URL or try again from the home page.
